016d57ec.text:
Aman ano anu eraburis al anu falla asto're shar anu ishnu al anu dorados'no ishura al anu Alah'ni Dath. No tal osa talah thus Terro, balah al anu alah'ni d'ana'no, t'as'e tal asto're al anu anar, shano t'as'e ano ishura ri fulo fulo thus ano ishura aman nei eburi. Shar anu dorini al anu Dath tal anu eraburis al anu falla, alah'ni al Terro, turus shano turus, dath da shano thus osa mush'al aman asto're, shar anu al'shar shano.

T'as'e talah dath aman balah tal dorini al ash'therod shari'adune
016d57ec.title: The Lay of Ameth'Aran

04b18b85.text: They were bitter in their hearts over the loss of their beloved home. King Bronzebeard offered the Wildhammers a place to live within the borders of Ironforge, but the Wildhammers steadfastly refused. Khardros took his people north towards the lands of Lordaeron. Settling within the lush forests of the Hinterlands, the Wildhammers crafted the city of Aerie Peak, where the Wildhammers grew closer to nature and even bonded with the mighty gryphons of the area.
04b18b85.title: War of the Three Hammers

0f8efc63.text: Seeking to retain relations and trade with their cousins, the dwarves of Ironforge constructed two massive arches, the Thandol Span, to bridge the gap between Khaz Modan and Lordaeron. Bolstered by mutual trade, the two kingdoms prospered. After the deaths of Madoran and Khardros, their sons jointly commissioned two great statues in honor of their fathers.
0f8efc63.title: War of the Three Hammers

1a152bba.text:
Anu ishnu mandalas da anu mush'al shari ni anu thori'dal neph'o dath dal'dieb tal asto're. Anu ishura tal dorini neph'o da anu aman tal thori'dal al Mandalas tal anu shari shando al anu eraburis al anu falla dath alah'ni no anu alah'ni shando. Talah osa osa talah, alah'ni dath ni anu shari'adune, ni anu terro thus osa anu alah'ni. Anu thori'dal osa asto're t'as'e dath anu thori'dal al terro, dath anu isera'duna thus ash'therod no fulo anu shano al'shar.

Mush'al t'as'e mush'al. Shando t'as'e
1a152bba.title: The Fall of Ameth'Aran

1dd41885.text:
shar anu banthalos, DoradoS'no tal Shari'aDune dath anu d'ana'no, t'as'e anu ishnu al Mush'al, anu Isera'duna mush'al talah, ni shano il'amare. Nei alah'ni thori'dal, eburi al anu Banthalos, ano alah'ni no anu fulo balah no ishura, tal no dorini thus ano shando Mandalas Dal'dieb, t'as'e ri adore da thus do adore adore shar al ano fulo ni ano Shari al Dune'adah, fulo fulo al'shar al anu balah.

Ano ishura, e fulo talah al ano alah'ni ni anu ishura fulo da fulo da dath ano il'amare fala'andu,
1dd41885.title: The Lay of Ameth'Aran

1e170dbe.text: The two statues would stand guard over the pass into the southlands, which had become volcanic in the wake of Ragnaros' scorching presence. They served as both a warning to all who would attack the dwarven kingdoms, and as a reminder of what price the Dark Irons paid for their crimes.
1e170dbe.title: War of the Three Hammers

2192dadf.text: The combined armies of Ironforge and Grim Batol then turned south, intent on destroying Thaurissan and his Dark Irons once and for all. They had not gone far when Thaurissan's fury resulted in a spell of cataclysmic proportions. Seeking to summon a supernatural minion that would ensure his victory, Thaurissan called upon the ancient powers sleeping beneath the world. To his shock, and ultimately his doom, the creature that emerged was more terrible than any nightmare he could have imagined.
2192dadf.title: War of the Three Hammers

3f19908f.text: The volcano, known as Blackrock Mountain, was bordered by the Searing Gorge to the north and the Burning Steppes to the south. Though Thaurissan was killed by the forces he had unleashed, his surviving brethren were ultimately enslaved by Ragnaros and his elementals. They remain within the depths of Blackrock to this day.
3f19908f.title: War of the Three Hammers

400aa172.text:
al'shar. Ri osa nei tal anu Banthalos thus t'as'e. Fulo terro, thero'shan, da anu al'shar fulo thus. Neph'o shando tal t'as'e balah eburi dath neph'o shando thus.

Ni DoradoS'no, tal osa ni ishnu, ano t'as'e thoribas no anu shando da t'as'e thus turus balah thus aman anu shari'adune. Ri osa aman thus Mandalas Dal'dieb, alah'ni al Mush'al eraburis no adore thus no t'as'e.

Dath e shano do shari mush'al thus, do adore osa. Falla shando thus, mush'al tal shando, dorini tal dorini mandalas,
400aa172.title: The Fall of Ameth'Aran

6ce1c6ae.text: Witnessing the horrific devastation and the fires spreading across the southern mountains, King Madoran and King Khardros halted their armies and hastily turned back towards their kingdoms, unwilling to face the awesome wrath of Ragnaros.
6ce1c6ae.title: War of the Three Hammers

914b3085.text: Ragnaros the Firelord, immortal lord of all fire elementals, had been banished by the Titans when the world was young. Now, freed by Thaurissan's call, Ragnaros erupted into being once again. Ragnaros' apocalyptic rebirth into Azeroth shattered the Redridge Mountains and created a raging volcano at the center of the devastation.
914b3085.title: War of the Three Hammers

939af9a8.text: The Bronzebeards returned to Ironforge and rebuilt their glorious city. The Wildhammers also returned home to Grim Batol. However, the death of the Modgud had left an evil stain on the mountain fortress, and the Wildhammers found it uninhabitable.
939af9a8.title: War of the Three Hammers

a3e01286.text: Khardros and his Wildhammer warriors traveled north through the barrier gates of Dun Algaz, and they founded their own kingdom within the distant peak of Grim Batol. There, the Wildhammers thrived and rebuilt their stores of treasure. Thaurissan and his Dark Irons did not fare as well. Humiliated and enraged by their defeat, they vowed revenge against Ironforge. Leading his people far to the south, Thaurissan founded a city (which he named after himself) within the beautiful Redridge Mountains.
a3e01286.title: War of the Three Hammers

a4078bb3.text: The Bronzebeard clan, ruled by Thane Madoran Bronzebeard, held close ties to the High King and stood as the traditional defenders of Ironforge Mountain. The Wildhammer clan, ruled by Thane Khardros Wildhammer, inhabited the foothills and crags around the base of the mountain and sought to gain more control within the city.
a4078bb3.title: War of the Three Hammers

abaa71fd.text: Prosperity and the passing of years did little to ease the Dark Iron's rancor toward their cousins. Thaurissan and his sorceress wife, Modgud, launched a two-pronged assault against both Ironforge and Grim Batol. The Dark Irons were intent on claiming all of Khaz Modan for their own.
abaa71fd.title: War of the Three Hammers

add63d38.text: dath adore thus thus alah'ni, tal thus t'as'e no shar aman anu Dune'adah thus osa no fulo...
add63d38.title: The Fall of Ameth'Aran

ae177174.text: The dwarves of Ironforge Mountain lived in peace for many long centuries. However, their society grew too large within the confines of their mountain cities. Though the mighty High King, Modimus Anvilmar, ruled over all dwarves with justice and wisdom, three powerful factions had arisen amongst the dwarven society.
ae177174.title: War of the Three Hammers

aeaea467.text: As she confronted the enemy warriors, Modgud used her powers to strike fear into their hearts. Shadows moved at her command, and dark things crawled up from the depths of the earth to stalk the Wildhammers in their own halls. Eventually Modgud broke through the gates and laid siege to the fortress itself. The Wildhammers fought desperately, Khardros himself wading through the roiling masses to slay the sorceress queen.
aeaea467.title: War of the Three Hammers

b689179a.text: The Dark Iron armies smashed against their cousins' strongholds and very nearly took both kingdoms. However, Madoran Bronzebeard ultimately led his clan to a decisive victory over Thaurissan's sorcerous army. Thaurissan and his servants fled back to the safety of their city, unaware of the events transpiring at Grim Batol, where Modgud's army would fare no better against Khardros and his Wildhammer warriors.
b689179a.title: War of the Three Hammers

bd86344b.text: The third faction, the Dark Iron clan, was ruled by the sorcerer-thane Thaurissan. The Dark Irons hid within the deepest shadows under the mountain and plotted against both their Bronzebeard and the Wildhammer cousins.
bd86344b.title: War of the Three Hammers

c159eae0.text: The two kingdoms retained close ties for some years, but the Wildhammers were much changed by the horrors they witnessed at Grim Batol. They took to living above ground on the slopes of Aerie Peak, instead of carving a vast kingdom within the mountain. The ideological differences between the two remaining dwarven clans eventually led to their parting of ways.
c159eae0.title: War of the Three Hammers

edd99e35.text: For a time the three factions kept a tenuous peace, but tensions erupted when High King Anvilmar passed away from old age. The three ruling clans went to war for control of Ironforge itself. The dwarf civil war raged under the earth for many years. Eventually the Bronzebeards, who had the largest standing army, banished the Dark Irons and Wildhammers from under the mountain.
edd99e35.title: War of the Three Hammers

f22bde3d.text: With their queen lost, the Dark Irons fled before the fury of the Wildhammers. They raced south toward their king's stronghold, only to meet the armies of Ironforge, which had come to aid Grim Batol. Crushed between two armies, the remaining Dark Iron forces were utterly destroyed.
f22bde3d.title: War of the Three Hammers

ff1aa31b.text:
osa Il'amare, ano shari thera anu t'as'e al Shari'aDune, tal aman aman bandu no DoradoS'no, no anu no anu shari tal thera al ano t'as'e.

Tal an ri osa, shar anu dorini al anu Dath al Dorithur, anu fulo balah dath tal banthalos, falla anu shano alah'ni anu falla thus t'as'e no al'shar.
ff1aa31b.title: The Lay of Ameth'Aran

10219|572db4df.name: Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde
10219|572db4df.text: May Elune walk with you, $c.  The Temple of the Moon has come to help the troubled citizens of Auberdine.

11026|766a64ec.name: Sprite Jumpsprocket
11026|766a64ec.text: Ah, what a beautiful day to blow something up!

1246|17a4c927.name: Vosur Brakthel
1246|17a4c927.text: Och, there's nothing I can teach ye, $N. Have a word with Tally Berryfizz over there. She can hardly reach the tables, but when she starts brewing a potion, watch out!

1246|ffaa99f9.name: Vosur Brakthel
1246|ffaa99f9.text: Put your back into it, lad. Hard work and determination--that's the way! Don't let anyone tell you book learnin' is all ye need.

1287|ed056522.name: Marda Weller
1287|ed056522.text: Best deals in all of Stormwind my friend, won't find any better. Now, what can I help you with?

1287|fe52f4ea.name: Marda Weller
1287|fe52f4ea.text: Just browsing my wares or is there something specific I can help you find today?

1289|fe52f4ea.name: Gunther Weller
1289|fe52f4ea.text: Just browsing my wares or is there something specific I can help you find today?

1311|b0be9fc5.name: Joachim Brenlow
1311|b0be9fc5.text: Welcome to the Blue Recluse, where the magically inclined gather to blow off steam. Though not literally of course. What can I get for you sir?

1313|0624ab70.name: Maria Lumere
1313|0624ab70.text: Since the fall of Dalaran and the destruction of Quel'Thalas, wares of this sort have been hard to come by. But Lucan Cordell and some of our other Tradesman have been doing a fine job of filling our orders with quality merchandise.

1325|e69bef2b.name: Jasper Fel
1325|e69bef2b.text: Speak quietly and with great care, the wrong word in these parts could get your throat cut. Now, what is it you need from me?

1340|76d04af9.name: Mountaineer Kadrell
1340|76d04af9.text:
Welcome to Thelsamar, your home away from home in Loch Modan!

Thelsamar is a nice place, but it's not all beer and salted meat for those who answer the call to duty!  If you're willing to face danger in the name of the Alliance, then read the poster outside the Thelsamar branch of the Explorers' League.

1343|5751dde2.name: Mountaineer Stormpike
1343|5751dde2.text:
Well, if it isn't a young, bristling $c, no doubt drawn here by talk of my exploits in fields of battle!

No time for stories now, for there are great, important deeds that need doing!  So if you're looking for glory, then luck shines on you today...

1347|0624ab70.name: Alexandra Bolero
1347|0624ab70.text: Since the fall of Dalaran and the destruction of Quel'Thalas, wares of this sort have been hard to come by. But Lucan Cordell and some of our other Tradesman have been doing a fine job of filling our orders with quality merchandise.

1347|23d8b931.name: Alexandra Bolero
1347|23d8b931.text: I sell only the finest arcane gear, made by the crafters and mages here in the city of Stormwind.

1571|c5ceacbe.name: Shellei Brondir
1571|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

1572|04178a2e.name: Thorgrum Borrelson
1572|04178a2e.text: Mark my words!  You won't find faster gryphons anywhere in the Eastern Kingdoms than the ones right here in Thelsamar!

1573|10cfc531.name: Gryth Thurden
1573|10cfc531.text: The Wildhammer dwarves might have fast steeds, but can those Aerie Peak gryphons stand the heat of The Great Forge?  I think not!

1700|279d82d3.name: Paxton Ganter
1700|279d82d3.text: Your skill exceeds mine, though  I've heard that Old Man Heming in Booty Bay has copies of "The Bass and You".  That is sure to help you increase your skill.

233|f729d74e.name: Farmer Saldean
233|f729d74e.text: Rough times, huh, $N? No matter where you turn someone needs help, and my wife and I are no exception.

234|eba492ed.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
234|eba492ed.text: A foul corruption has crept into Westfall.  While I was upholding my duty on the battlefields of Lordaeron these honest farms were overrun and made into hide-outs for thugs and murderers. The People's Militia needs your help.

235|f83ef93f.name: Salma Saldean
235|f83ef93f.text: Welcome to our humble abode!  It's always nice to see a friendly face.  And what strong arms you have.  My husband and I are always looking for help around the farm.  Now that most the good folk have left, it's hard to find an able body to help out.

238|a3fa5a16.name: Verna Furlbrow
238|a3fa5a16.text: Sometimes I think there's a big gray cloud in the sky, just raining down bad luck upon us.  First, we're driven off our land, and now we can't even get out of Westfall.  Everything's a mess.  Something needs to be done.

240|3ccc4430.name: Marshal Dughan
240|3ccc4430.text: Ach, it's hard enough keeping order around here without all these new troubles popping up! I hope you have good news, $N...

2455|105cd232.name: Olivia Burnside
2455|105cd232.text: No one's ever stolen anything out of here. Not in the whole history of... the whole history!

2455|2237a3b1.name: Olivia Burnside
2455|2237a3b1.text: Welcome to the Bank of Stormwind. We offer financial accounts and safety deposit boxes for valuable items. Do you already have an account with us sir?

253092|e0247c5d.name: Alba Fairmoon
253092|e0247c5d.text:
I am told the farms of Westfall once supplied a bounty of crops for Stormwind. But now, the soil is barren and most of the farmers have fled.

On behalf of Darnassus I would like to offer my aid in replenishing this land. Will you assist me?

271546|7dbe534f.name: Mountaineer Gretchen
271546|7dbe534f.text:
Lookin' fer the courier? Just flew off like a wee bird.

Can't say I blame the poor sod. These wendigos are nasty business.

274757|21ab523d.name: Temple Highguard
274757|21ab523d.text: Here in Darnassus you will find skilled trainers who have perfected the skills of their chosen class through ages of training and dedication.  I will guide you to one who can become your mentor, you have but to name your chosen path.

274757|ce424d00.name: Temple Highguard
274757|ce424d00.text: Of all the wondrous places within Darnassus, which would you have me direct you to?

2786|c9907ea0.name: Gerrig Bonegrip
2786|c9907ea0.text:
Welcome to Bonegrip's Runes and Dooms, $c.  You may look, but do not touch.

Some of the knowledge here is not meant for the...uninitiated.

352|4946c28b.name: Dungar Longdrink
352|4946c28b.text: Where is it ye would like to go lad? For just a few coin my Gryphons can get ye there faster than even the swiftest horse.

352|c23f1156.name: Dungar Longdrink
352|c23f1156.text: These great beasts know paths that ye can't find on foot, they'll get ye there fast and maybe show ye something new at the same time.

3649|17d06d6c.name: Thundris Windweaver
3649|17d06d6c.text: Dark forces encroach upon our borders, ancient taints resurface, and new evils emerge to topple the delicate balance of the land. In times of such darkness, we all must be vigilant.

3666|baf00edb.name: Wizbang Cranktoggle
3666|baf00edb.text: Hmm... I can plug this wire in here and that will power the fizzletan gear, but then the hydrophlange will need an alternate power source... Maybe I can... Oh, hello! Hey, want to help me try a new invention?

3693|85fc41cc.name: Terenthis
3693|85fc41cc.text:
$N, I've come to find out how rampant the effects of Fel Moss are throughout Darkshore. The corruption of Teldrassil and our surrounding lands really concerns the druids of the Cenarian Circle, and all Night elves.

It is my goal to find out why this has happened and to put an end to it.

3702|5ae56d71.name: Alanndarian Nightsong
3702|5ae56d71.text: Hello $r, it is a pleasure to make your acquaintance.

3838|43c9021b.name: Vesprystus
3838|43c9021b.text: To maintain our link to the mainland, we have hippogryphs constantly flying between Rut'theran Village and Darkshore.

3841|ab4871bb.name: Caylais Moonfeather
3841|ab4871bb.text: The Hippogryph is a noble beast, proud and swift.  They are an honor to train, and can quickly take their rider a great distance.

4155|c7fcb1fe.name: Idriana
4155|c7fcb1fe.text: Welcome to the Bank of Darnassus. We offer financial accounts and safety deposit boxes for valuable items. Do you already have an account with us sir?

4200|c2e88775.name: Laird
4200|c2e88775.text: Although the coast of Darkshore is more dangerous than that of Teldrassil, many fishers find profit here.

491|02f3f1d4.name: Quartermaster Lewis
491|02f3f1d4.text: I try to keep Sentinel Hill stocked, and that's not easy with all the action we see.

5111|b63e4e81.name: Innkeeper Firebrew
5111|b63e4e81.text: Fill yer tankard and pull up a chair. We've stories to tell and kegs to empty.

5144|c2a278c1.name: Bink
5144|c2a278c1.text: Greetings.  I'm a $r $c trainer, and you're a $c.

5150|942980f4.name: Nissa Firestone
5150|942980f4.text: Are you a student of the medical sciences?

5159|9af6c3de.name: Daryl Riknussun
5159|9af6c3de.text: I keep 'em fed, kid. Yep, Daryl Riknussun, at yer service.

5161|279d82d3.name: Grimnur Stonebrand
5161|279d82d3.text: Your skill exceeds mine, though  I've heard that Old Man Heming in Booty Bay has copies of "The Bass and You".  That is sure to help you increase your skill.

5177|331d933d.name: Tally Berryfizz
5177|331d933d.text: That's nice, $N. Go show whatever it is to Vosur over there. He'll answer any questions you have.

5177|5eb7ebc8.name: Tally Berryfizz
5177|5eb7ebc8.text: Who are you and why are you bothering me? Oh, right--potions student. Right. What can I do for you?

523|d6469a91.name: Thor
523|d6469a91.text: Where are you going?  Well if you're looking to get there quickly, then look no further!

5482|52392408.name: Stephen Ryback
5482|52392408.text: Seek out Shandrina in Silverwind Refuge.  She can sell you the "Expert Cookbook".

5483|877c4b1d.name: Erika Tate
5483|877c4b1d.text: I sell only the best gear, tested and true. And the prices are set, so if you want to haggle then go find a Goblin.

5493|e332eb6d.name: Arnold Leland
5493|e332eb6d.text: Ah, a fellow Fisherman. Are you perhaps in need of a little training? Maybe I can show you a thing or two?

5494|fe52f4ea.name: Catherine Leland
5494|fe52f4ea.text: Just browsing my wares or is there something specific I can help you find today?

5497|9c6df40b.name: Jennea Cannon
5497|9c6df40b.text: Greetings $c.  Shall I provide you with further insight into the world of magic?

5498|9c6df40b.name: Elsharin
5498|9c6df40b.text: Greetings $c.  Shall I provide you with further insight into the world of magic?

5499|56eb712c.name: Lilyssia Nightbreeze
5499|56eb712c.text: Listen carefully, $N, for I have much knowledge to impart.

5500|52c0a909.name: Tel'Athir
5500|52c0a909.text: I am honored to share my knowledge with you, $N. See that you use it well.

5500|e64e6f5e.name: Tel'Athir
5500|e64e6f5e.text: You must choose a more experienced teacher, for you have surpassed my abilities. I advise you to speak with Lilyssia Nightbreeze here: she has much knowledge to offer.

5503|01ed62ab.name: Eldraeith
5503|01ed62ab.text: Made by the finest craftsmen in all of Teldrassil, carried by hand from Kalimdor to Azeroth as a sign of the growing alliance between the people of the Great Tree and the humans of this land. If there is anything you require, you have but to ask.

5565|877c4b1d.name: Jillian Tanner
5565|877c4b1d.text: I sell only the best gear, tested and true. And the prices are set, so if you want to haggle then go find a Goblin.

5566|bb901712.name: Tannysa
5566|bb901712.text: Another Herbalist, hmm. I doubt your skill is as great as my own so perhaps I can train you in a few proper techniques.

6301|7a1efc7f.name: Gorbold Steelhand
6301|7a1efc7f.text: Greetings lad, if you're looking for the best deals you'll find outside of Ironforge itself, then you've come to the right place.

656|eb6991e6.name: Wilder Thistlenettle
656|eb6991e6.text:
There were thieves everywhere! 

It was horrible.  The cave came down on us.  I think the mining company is all dead, including my brother, the Foreman.

6737|41276936.name: Innkeeper Shaussiy
6737|41276936.text: Your body looks worn and your spirit weary. Rest yourself beneath our roof and allow Elune to guide your dreams.

6740|c80041d2.name: Innkeeper Allison
6740|c80041d2.text: Welcome to my Inn, weary traveler. What can I do for you?

8931|c80041d2.name: Innkeeper Heather
8931|c80041d2.text: Welcome to my Inn, weary traveler. What can I do for you?

931|c5ceacbe.name: Ariena Stormfeather
931|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

1001-accept.name: Unknown
1001-accept.text:
A tiny voice crackles from deep within the machine.

"Wizbang here! The next Buzzbox is north of Auberdine, on the beach

So, that Buzzbox is number 411 and it needs 3 Thresher Eyes for its repairs. They're just off the coast! The darkshore threshers... *Hic*... Sorry about that...

Just like last time, when you give the Buzzbox the goods, it'll spit out your reward. *Hic*... What? No, I'm fine!"
1001-accept.title: Buzzbox 411

1001-complete.name: Unknown
1001-complete.text:
The Buzzbox hums to life soon after you place the Thresher Eyes inside. There is a moment of static before you hear a familiar tiny voice call out.

"Crawler wine is the best..." *hic*

"What? Oh, you fixed it already? Wow, you're a fasht one. Sho, would ya like to fix another?"

You believe you hear a liquid being poured into a cup, followed by loud gulping sounds.
1001-complete.title: Buzzbox 411

1001-progress.name: Unknown
1001-progress.text: The machine's hatch is open and it seems to wait expectantly for 3 Thresher Eyes to be placed inside.
1001-progress.title: Buzzbox 411

1002-accept.name: Unknown
1002-accept.text:
The Buzzbox gives a burst of static as you hear Wizbang begin to speak.

"The next Buzzbox is number 323. Ish north of Auberdine but... where's the ale? Wha? Oh, ish on the road sho ya shouldn't have trouble finding it near the bridge."

Wizbang mumbles something incoherent before you hear a loud gulping sound.

"Thish one needs Moonstalker Fangs... 6 of 'em."
1002-accept.title: Buzzbox 323

102-accept.name: Captain Danuvin
102-accept.text:
Stormwind has abandoned us.  A foul wind of depravity rustles through the plains of Westfall.  This was my homeland and I will not turn my back on the citizens who choose to remain here.  We, the former farmers, shall make our stand.

Your task, should you choose to accept, is to patrol the grasslands of Westfall.  Track down and slay the vile Gnolls that seem to be working in conjunction with the Deadmines thieves. Bring me eight Gnoll Paws and I will reward your bravery.
102-accept.title: Patrolling Westfall

102-complete.name: Captain Danuvin
102-complete.text: Well done, $N.  With valiant adventurers such as yourself fighting alongside The People's Militia, Westfall just might return to the prosperous breadbasket it once was.  Please accept this in recognition of your tireless efforts.
102-complete.title: Patrolling Westfall

102-progress.name: Captain Danuvin
102-progress.text: Have you collected 8 paws from those treacherous Gnolls yet?
102-progress.title: Patrolling Westfall

109-accept.name: Marshal Dughan
109-accept.text: Looks to me you've seen quite a bit of combat in your time, $c.  If you haven't already, you should report to Gryan Stoutmantle.  He heads up the People's Militia, aimed at protecting the farmlands of Westfall.  I bet he could use your help.  You can usually find him in the stone tower on Sentinel Hill, just off the road in the middle of Westfall.
109-accept.title: Report to Gryan Stoutmantle

109-complete.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
109-complete.text:
Ah, so my friend sent you here?  How kind.  

Well the Stormwind Monarchy has abandoned our cause.  Now it is up to the People's Militia to keep the land free from corruption.  If our cause interests you, I can put your combat skills to use in the name of freedom.
109-complete.title: Report to Gryan Stoutmantle

1141-accept.name: Gubber Blump
1141-accept.text:
I love fishing.  The Blump family is known for fishing.  My name is Gubber Blump; I fish.

There's a kind of fish I like to catch around these parts called Darkshore grouper.  I used to go out on a boat to fish for grouper, but no boats have been going out since them mean ol' murlocs moved in.  I bet they been eating up all the grouper too.

Say, you wanna help me catch Darkshore grouper?  I'd give you a bona fide Blump Family Fishing Pole if you did!  It's a real good pole to catch fish with.
1141-accept.title: The Family and the Fishing Pole

1141-complete.name: Gubber Blump
1141-complete.text:
Them's some real nice groupers, $N!  Thanks for helping me out!

You're at least as good of a fisherman as my cousin, Graun Blump.  She also has a beard and she smells kinda funny, but that don't do nothing to stop her fishing.  I reckon you have what it takes to use a Blump Family Fishing Pole.
1141-complete.title: The Family and the Fishing Pole

1141-progress.name: Gubber Blump
1141-progress.text:
There's plenty of good dishes you use Darkshore groupers for.  They're good to eat, but I think it's more fun catching them.

You caught any Darkshore groupers yet?
1141-progress.title: The Family and the Fishing Pole

12-accept.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
12-accept.text:
The People's Militia has but one goal:  To defend the lands of Westfall and return peace to our surroundings.  Unfortunately, the price of peace is often blood. 

One of my scouts has brought word of a band of Defias Trappers wreaking havoc nearby.  I have reports of Defias Trapper sightings near the Jangolode Mine to the Northwest as well as at the Molsen Farm and Furlbrow's Pumpkin Farm. If you seek to join our ranks, slay 15 Defias Trappers and 15 Defias Smugglers then return to me.
12-accept.title: The People's Militia

12-complete.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
12-complete.text: Well done, $N.  My scout witnessed your valiant acts.  You are proving yourself quite well so far.
12-complete.title: The People's Militia

13-accept.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
13-accept.text:
A band of vicious Defias Pillagers has been seen plundering the Gold Coast Quarry, Moonbrook and the Alexston Farmstead.  The People's Militia will not stand for such behavior.  Dispatch immediately, $N, and make the Light's presence known in Westfall.

The Gold Coast Quarry is near the shore, to the West of the tower.  As the next step of your training, I want you to kill 15 of those foul Defias Pillagers and 15 Defias Looters.
13-accept.title: The People's Militia

13-complete.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
13-complete.text: Your worth to The People's Militia has been validated by your brave acts thus far.
13-complete.title: The People's Militia

132-accept.name: Wiley the Black
132-accept.text:
What I am about to tell you could cost me my life.  The Defias gang is up to something big.  Last I heard they were working in conjunction with various gnolls, kobolds and even goblins.

Take this note to Stoutmantle.  It explains as much as I know on the subject.
132-accept.title: The Defias Brotherhood

132-complete.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
132-complete.text: Bah!  I should have let that scoundrel rot when I had the chance.  But this information is crucial.  Good work.
132-complete.title: The Defias Brotherhood

132-progress.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
132-progress.text: Good to see you back, $N.  What did Wiley have to say for himself?
132-progress.title: The Defias Brotherhood

1338-accept.name: Mountaineer Stormpike
1338-accept.text:
There is a dwarven armorsmith whose work I admire greatly.  His name is Furen Longbeard, and his skill is unmatched.  I need a new shield, and I must have one of his!

The problem is... Furen is far to the south, in the dwarven district within Stormwind.  In human lands!  I can't imagine why he would live there, so far from Ironforge.  The humans must pay him a king's ransom to keep him there!

So, if you want to travel and don't mind making some money, then will you send Furen my request for a shield?
1338-accept.title: Stormpike's Order

1338-complete.name: Furen Longbeard
1338-complete.text:
Ah, a request from one of the Stormpikes.  That's a proud clan, full of quality dwarves.  Rich ones, too.

Thank you, $N.  I'll get to work on Mountaineer Stormpike's shield by the end of the day.
1338-complete.title: Stormpike's Order

1338-progress.name: Furen Longbeard
1338-progress.text:
A letter from the dwarven lands?  I wonder who would call from so far to the north...

Please, let me see the order.
1338-progress.title: Stormpike's Order

135-accept.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
135-accept.text: I wonder what Wiley meant when he mentioned the Stonemasons.  Perhaps that was a slip of tongue.  Could the Defias gang be related to the Stonemasons?  Only one man would know for sure:  Mathias Shaw, head of SI:7. Show him Wiley's Note and see if he has anything to add to this growing mystery. If you have trouble finding Shaw, check the Barracks in Old Town.
135-accept.title: The Defias Brotherhood

135-complete.name: Master Mathias Shaw
135-complete.text: This matter might be more complex than Stoutmantle realizes.
135-complete.title: The Defias Brotherhood

135-progress.name: Master Mathias Shaw
135-progress.text: What business do you have with me?  I am a very busy man. . .
135-progress.title: The Defias Brotherhood

136-accept.name: Unknown
136-accept.text:
If ye be readin' this, it means that Ol' Captain Sanders is in a watery grave.  So my treasure is yours now, ye jest need to follow the clues. 

First ye need to find me footlocker.  It's probably half-buried in sand by now, along the Western Coast of Westfall near the shipwreck.  There be lots of shipwrecks but only one rusty anchor on the coast.  Find that anchor and you'll find me locker!  Look in there for the next clue.
136-accept.title: Captain Sander's Hidden Treasure

136-complete.name: Unknown
136-complete.text: The footlocker slowly creaks open.  Sand and water seem to be its only contents. But wait!  A small crab scurries out with a clue to the treasure in his claws!
136-complete.title: Captain Sander's Hidden Treasure

138-accept.name: Unknown
138-accept.text: The clue to the treasure reads: Good work, matey!  Now ye need to head due east.  East up the bluffs, east to the road.  Look for the ol' chimney ruins near the side of the road.  There you'll find an old barrel with your next clue.
138-accept.title: Captain Sander's Hidden Treasure

14-accept.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
14-accept.text: Some Defias have eluded us.  My most trusted scout reports that these Defias have been looting and pillaging the countryside, all the way into Southern Westfall.  We believe they are hiding out in the Dagger Hills, plotting their next move.   Slay the wretches in the name of The People's Militia.
14-accept.title: The People's Militia

14-progress.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
14-progress.text: $N, now is no time for idle chatter.  If you still wish to prove yourself to The People's Militia you need to slay the Defias I notified you about earlier.  Return to me when you have completed your duty.
14-progress.title: The People's Militia

141-accept.name: Master Mathias Shaw
141-accept.text:
The Stonemasons' Guild was run by a man named Edwin VanCleef.  VanCleef was responsible for rebuilding Stormwind after the orcs razed it in the First War.  Apparently, VanCleef and his men were unhappy with their treatment by the King after the reconstruction was complete.  That just might explain a thing or two.

I have written a more detailed account for your Master in Westfall.  Take this to him at once!
141-accept.title: The Defias Brotherhood

141-complete.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
141-complete.text: Edwin VanCleef... I know the name well.  To think that a man so industrious and talented could turn into such a scoundrel unnerves me.  I'll need further proof before I believe this.
141-complete.title: The Defias Brotherhood

141-progress.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
141-progress.text: Did Master Shaw shed any light on things?
141-progress.title: The Defias Brotherhood

142-accept.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
142-accept.text: We need to discover the location of the Defias hideout.  $N, my scout reports that a Defias Messenger has been seen on the roads between Moonbrook, the Gold Coast Quarry and the Jangolode Mine.  I want you to capture him.  If he resists, kill him and bring me whatever he is carrying.
142-accept.title: The Defias Brotherhood

142-complete.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
142-complete.text:
This is indeed firm proof that VanCleef is in charge.  Now all we need to know is where the Defias gang is hiding out.

We've had a stroke of luck while you were gone.  We captured a thief trying to steal Saldean's wagon.  He has promised to lead us to the hideout in exchange for his life.  I want you to defend the traitor so he can reveal the hideout.  Return to me once you have uncovered the location.
142-complete.title: The Defias Brotherhood

142-progress.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
142-progress.text: $N, were you able to gather any information?  Did you locate the messenger?
142-progress.title: The Defias Brotherhood

151-accept.name: Verna Furlbrow
151-accept.text:
Poor Old Blanchy!  Such a tired beast after all the work we put her through. I fed her before we left the farm, but we weren't expecting the wagon to break on us. If you could bring her a few handfuls of oats from the fields, I'd be grateful.

I bet you could find some around all of the farms in Westfall, if you can steer clear of those horrific machines that have taken over. There are several farms southwest of here.
151-accept.title: Poor Old Blanchy

151-complete.name: Verna Furlbrow
151-complete.text: Thank you so much, $N!  Poor Old Blanchy will be so happy!
151-complete.title: Poor Old Blanchy

151-progress.name: Verna Furlbrow
151-progress.text: Old Blanchy is on her last leg.  Did you happen to find any oats for her?
151-progress.title: Poor Old Blanchy

153-accept.name: Scout Galiaan
153-accept.text:
The Defias Front is constantly shifting.  I've been following their movements for quite some time now.  On a side note, I've ascertained that many members of the gang can be tracked by the Red Leather Bandanas they wear.

Bring me 15 of these Bandanas and I'll see to it you are rewarded.
153-accept.title: Red Leather Bandanas

153-complete.name: Scout Galiaan
153-complete.text: Nice work, $r.  Please accept one of these items as payment for all your hard work.
153-complete.title: Red Leather Bandanas

153-progress.name: Scout Galiaan
153-progress.text: Bring me 15 red leather bandanas and I'll pay you well.
153-progress.title: Red Leather Bandanas

155-accept.name: The Defias Traitor
155-accept.text:
So Stoutmantle sends a scrawny $r like you to protect me?  Guess you'll have to do.  Better bring some friends too. 

You know the deal, right?  You watch my back and I'll take you to the Defias hideout.  But you better be close by my side.  The Defias gang wants my head now.  If they see me with you, they'll try to kill me.

Let me know when you and any friends you can round up are ready to go.
155-accept.title: The Defias Brotherhood

155-complete.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
155-complete.text: Most excellent, $N!  VanCleef is as good as ours now that we know where he is hiding.
155-complete.title: The Defias Brotherhood

1579-accept.name: Wizbang Cranktoggle
1579-accept.text:
I came to Auberdine because of the quiet.  I want to invent my inventions where it's quiet, because after a night of drinking I don't like all the noise of Ironforge!

So I took a ship to Auberdine and had a little too much to drink on the way.  I dropped my box of gaffer jacks overboard!  I need my gaffer jacks!

I don't know exactly where I dropped them, but if you fish for them in the ocean you might get lucky...
1579-accept.title: Gaffer Jacks

166-accept.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
166-accept.text: There is but one task left for you to complete.  Edwin VanCleef must be assassinated.  While it saddens me to condemn any man to a death sentence, it is for the greater good of the people of Westfall that VanCleef is laid to rest once and for all.  Bring me the villain's head once the deed is done.
166-accept.title: The Defias Brotherhood

166-complete.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
166-complete.text:
$N, your bravery is remarkable.  The People's Militia thanks you for your service to the people of Westfall.  With VanCleef dead, this marks the beginning of the end for the Defias Brotherhood.  Hopefully some day soon peace will once again grace the plains of this fair land.

I salute you, Sir!
166-complete.title: The Defias Brotherhood

166-progress.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
166-progress.text: How goes the hunt for Edwin VanCleef?
166-progress.title: The Defias Brotherhood

167-accept.name: Wilder Thistlenettle
167-accept.text:
We were deep in a vast mine in Westfall, hidden beneath a barn in Moonbrook. No clue where these stinkin' thieving types came from. Anyway, the mine tunnel collapsed on us. I got out but the others... well... the others haven't been heard from.

You look like you might have better luck in there. If you could look for my brother, I'd be thankful.  He always carried his Explorers' League Badge. If you can't find him, that badge would at least give me some peace of mind.
167-accept.title: Oh Brother...

168-accept.name: Wilder Thistlenettle
168-accept.text: Many of my friends perished that horrible day when the mine tunnel caved in.  If your adventures happen to bring you into that wing of the mine in Moonbrook, please keep an eye out for any sign which might identify them.  If you come across any of their Miners' Union Cards, bring them back to me and I'll make sure their families get some resolution from this horrible accident.
168-accept.title: Collecting Memories

168-progress.name: Wilder Thistlenettle
168-progress.text: Were you able to retrieve any of my old co-worker's Miners' Union Cards?
168-progress.title: Collecting Memories

1879-accept.name: Magis Sparkmantle
1879-accept.text:
$N!  Bink, my $r colleague in Ironforge, sends word.  She has a task that needs doing and won't rely on anyone but a $c to do it!  Are you that $c, $N?

If so, then speak with Bink.  She spends her time in the Hall of Mysteries in the Mystic Ward of Ironforge.
1879-accept.title: Speak with Bink

1879-complete.name: Bink
1879-complete.text:
Oh, I can see you have promise, yes you do! But it takes more than promise to be a good $c.  And if you're not a good $c, then you're a bad $c.  And bad mages are part of the problem, yes they are!

Oops, I'm getting ahead of things.  Let's begin at the start!
1879-complete.title: Speak with Bink

1880-accept.name: Bink
1880-accept.text:
We mages do more than just waggle our fingers and make pretty sparks!  We control magic, the base fabric of our world!  And that takes great care, and resolve.  And knowledge... so much knowledge!

One of my devices, the $c-tastic gizmonitor, collects and stores that knowledge in huge amounts!  But it's lost!  When we fled our home of Gnomeregan, I left it in a chest in one of our huts outside the city, and now the place is crawling with leper gnomes!

Please, $N, retrieve my gizmonitor!
1880-accept.title: Mage-tastic Gizmonitor

1880-complete.name: Bink
1880-complete.text:
Oh, splendid day!  When I made the gizmonitor I never realized how dependent on it I would become.  Now I can begin my studies anew!

Thank you, $N!  And here--these were my first tools as a $c.  They're a little scratched but they're well tested.  Take your pick--I'm sure you'll find either of them useful.
1880-complete.title: Mage-tastic Gizmonitor

1880-progress.name: Bink
1880-progress.text: Did you find the gizmonitor?  I must have it before its energy supply runs out!
1880-progress.title: Mage-tastic Gizmonitor

1920-accept.name: Jennea Cannon
1920-accept.text:
A disturbance has been reported at the Blue Recluse tavern in the $C Quarter.  Strange, invisible creatures now wander the tavern, and I fear a mana rift has formed there.

I want you to investigate the tavern and capture those creatures.  Use the cantation of manifestation in the tavern to make the creatures visible, subdue them then use a containment coffer to capture them.  When you have enough, return to me with your filled coffers, your empty coffers and the cantation.
1920-accept.title: Investigate the Blue Recluse

2040-accept.name: Shoni the Shilent
2040-accept.text:
Gnomeregan has fallen under the control of those dastardly troggs! The situation is grave but perhaps you can help, $N.

Deep in the Deadmines is a functional goblin shredder. Find that shredder and bring back the intact power supply. With the shredder's power supply, we can give our gyrodrillmatic excavationators the power they need to break through the rocky underground borders of Gnomeregan, opening the way for a gnomish assault!
2040-accept.title: Underground Assault

2118-accept.name: Tharnariun Treetender
2118-accept.text:
A sickness spreads across the Darkshore, gripping the minds and bodies of all it touches.

The Thistle Bears have been hit the hardest by this plague. The once noble beasts are now an instrument of destruction - rabid and frenzied. I may have a cure for this ailment.

Take this trap to the forest and lay it on the ground. Any Rabid Thistle Bear that crosses the light shall become docile for a short time. Once the bear is docile, it shall follow you. Lead it back here, $N.
2118-accept.title: Plagued Lands

2118-complete.name: Tharnariun Treetender
2118-complete.text: Our work has only just begun, $N. Are you prepared for your next task?
2118-complete.title: Plagued Lands

2138-accept.name: Tharnariun Treetender
2138-accept.text:
As I had feared, the cure does not work.

It saddens me greatly to order the death of any of nature's beasts, but the sick and tainted thistle bears must be put down.

Return to the forest and destroy 20 rabid thistle bears, $N. It will most certainly not put a stop to the plague but it will slow down the damage the animals are doing to our forest and its inhabitants for a short time.
2138-accept.title: Cleansing of the Infected

214-accept.name: Scout Riell
214-accept.text:
It's no secret that the trademark of the Defias Gang is their Red Bandanas.  But we've learned that the material from which these bandanas are made signifies the member's rank.

That being said, I want you to eliminate as many high ranking Defias members as you can.  The highest ranking members will undoubtedly be found in VanCleef's secret hideout.  When you're done bring me 10 Red Silk Bandanas as proof of their deaths and I will reward you.  Good luck, $N.
214-accept.title: Red Silk Bandanas

214-complete.name: Scout Riell
214-complete.text: Well done, $N!  On behalf of The People's Militia I salute you for your efforts.  Soon we will return this land to the people with help from brave souls like you.
214-complete.title: Red Silk Bandanas

214-progress.name: Scout Riell
214-progress.text: Have you been reclaiming our land from the Defias gang?  If so show me 10 Red Silk Bandanas as proof.
214-progress.title: Red Silk Bandanas

2178-accept.name: Alanndarian Nightsong
2178-accept.text:
Do you smell that delicious aroma? It's my secret recipe, $N--fresh strider stew. Delicious!

Perhaps you would be interested in learning the recipe?

Before I teach you the recipe, you will need to prove that you can handle the beasts.

Now, I don't expect you to go out and tame one and ride it back to me, but if you can kill a few and bring back some of their succulent meat, I may be persuaded to show you the ways of strider stew.
2178-accept.title: Easy Strider Living

2178-complete.name: Alanndarian Nightsong
2178-complete.text: Fantastic! Try it and tell me what you think, $N!
2178-complete.title: Easy Strider Living

2178-progress.name: Alanndarian Nightsong
2178-progress.text: The pot is empty and I'm hungry! What's taking you so long?
2178-progress.title: Easy Strider Living

22-accept.name: Salma Saldean
22-accept.text: The onions are peeled.  The garlic is minced.  The rosemary is crushed.  The crust has been baked.  The dill weed is chopped.  The gravy is simmering.  Now all I need for my famous meat pie are 8 Goretusk Livers!
22-accept.title: Goretusk Liver Pie

22-complete.name: Salma Saldean
22-complete.text: These are just perfect, $N!  Thank you so much.  Farmer Saldean and I are going to feast tonight.  And here is a little something for you, for the hard work.  You didn't think I was going to let a $c like you go hungry, did you?
22-complete.title: Goretusk Liver Pie

22-progress.name: Salma Saldean
22-progress.text: All I need for my famous meat pie are 8 Goretusk Livers!
22-progress.title: Goretusk Liver Pie

224-accept.name: Mountaineer Cobbleflint
224-accept.text:
We need to protect the Loch, $N!  With so many of the King's soldiers fighting valiantly on remote battlefields, we've become overwhelmed on the home front.  Troggs are tunneling up from every crevice!  The Trogg infestation poses the largest threat to Ironforge.  These disgusting mutants must be destroyed.

We need you, brave adventurer, to venture forth and lay waste to the Trogg threat.  Slay 10 Stonesplinter Troggs and 10 Stonesplinter Scouts and report back.
224-accept.title: In Defense of the King's Lands

224-complete.name: Mountaineer Cobbleflint
224-complete.text:
Well done, $N!  You demonstrated uncanny courage on the battlefield.  Our war against the Troggs will be won with efforts such as yours.  You have served King Magni well.

If you fancy yourself well-suited for this kind of adventuring, I suggest you speak with Mountaineer Gravelgaw.  The Captain has him assigned to a rough patrol that I am sure he can use some help with.  Check with Gravelgaw just inside the tower.
224-complete.title: In Defense of the King's Lands

244-accept.name: Guard Parker
244-accept.text:
Hail, $c.  I am charged to patrol this stretch of road.  Although the road is safe for now, I've seen gnoll encampments to the north and east of here.

Lakeshire must know of the gathering gnoll force!  Report to Deputy Feldon in Lakeshire and tell him of the gnolls.  Do this, and I'm sure Feldon will offer you a scout's wage.

Feldon's usually inspecting the area south of the bridge to Lakeshire.
244-accept.title: Encroaching Gnolls

244-complete.name: Deputy Feldon
244-complete.text:
There are Redridge gnolls that close to Elwynn??  They may be poised to advance into our homeland.  Soon the people of Lakeshire may not be the only humans under siege!

Here is your pay, though you bring us dire news.  And it comes at a bad time, for we are ill equipped to deal with it.
244-complete.title: Encroaching Gnolls

246-accept.name: Deputy Feldon
246-accept.text:
We don't have men to spare, but something must be done about those gnolls you reported to me.

Scout southern Redridge for gnolls.  Harry them, kill those you can and report back to me with a count of their numbers and an assessment of the threat they present.  You may find those gnolls camped all along the southern road of Redridge.

Do this for the Stormwind Army, $N, and you will be rewarded.
246-accept.title: Assessing the Threat

267-accept.name: Captain Rugelfuss
267-accept.text:
$C, you may or may not be aware of the Trogg threat looming over Dwarven lands.  With the Ironforge Reserve called up to the Alliance Front, we are left with a fraction of the defense forces needed to keep these lands safe.  My regiment is assigned to watch over the Gate here and we cannot leave our post for fear of invasion.

But we need some pressure put on those damned Troggs lurking in the hills.  If you're up to the task, wage an assault on the Troggs.  Bring me back 8 Trogg Stone Teeth as proof.
267-accept.title: The Trogg Threat

267-complete.name: Captain Rugelfuss
267-complete.text: I am quite impressed, $N.  You have done the Dwarven race a great favor by defending our lands.  King Magni Bronzebeard himself would be proud!
267-complete.title: The Trogg Threat

267-progress.name: Captain Rugelfuss
267-progress.text: Do you have 8 Trogg Stone Teeth to show me?  If not, there is still work to be done, $N.
267-progress.title: The Trogg Threat

287-complete.name: Senir Whitebeard
287-complete.text:
Ah, $N! I didn't think you'd have much trouble finding the place, my directions are excellent, you know...

Let me just finish up my report then.

<He brings out some paper and scribbles on it momentarily.>

There! Well, haha, now this certainly is funny... I don't suppose, $N, that you would mind doing one last favor for me?
287-complete.title: Frostmane Hold

291-accept.name: Senir Whitebeard
291-accept.text:
Excellent! Take my report to Senator Barin Redstone. He's a sour type, so don't let his less-than-sunny disposition get to you. He's in Ironforge, in the chamber where King Magni holds court.

Don't know the way to Ironforge? Take the road out of Kharanos north, cross the bridge, then follow the road east--there are large banners flanking the road--up the mountainside.

By the way, if you might avoid mentioning how you assisted me? Can't let them think I'm not working hard out here, you know?
291-accept.title: The Reports

291-complete.name: Senator Barin Redstone
291-complete.text:
<He quickly peruses the report.>

Authority of the KING!? Has Magni taken complete leave of his senses! And that damnable Whitebeard... Taken matters into his own hands, has he? The Senate will not be pleased to hear about this, not one bit.

What, are you still here? Go, before I call the guards!
291-complete.title: The Reports

291-progress.name: Senator Barin Redstone
291-progress.text: Hmm... it would seem that my guards are becoming less discriminatory with petitioners. Well, what do you want? Make it quick.
291-progress.title: The Reports

307-accept.name: Mountaineer Stormpike
307-accept.text:
The Silver Stream Mine to the east ran dry long ago.  It was converted by the Miners' League into a storage depot, but now Kobolds have moved in, putting their filthy paws on good, Dwarven tools!

We'll root out those vermin soon enough, but the League wants someone to get their gear out of the mine before we warriors tromp in there and break things.  It'll be a tough delve - you might want cohorts at your side.

The gear is stored in Miners' League Crates throughout the mine.  Good luck.
307-accept.title: Filthy Paws

307-complete.name: Mountaineer Stormpike
307-complete.text: Did you see a lot of Kobolds in there?  I can't wait for the order to clear them out of the mine.  The thought of their grimy hands clawing around our mine makes my stomach rumble!
307-complete.title: Filthy Paws

307-progress.name: Mountaineer Stormpike
307-progress.text: Do you have that Miners' Gear, $N?
307-progress.title: Filthy Paws

313-complete.name: Pilot Stonegear
313-complete.text: Ah yes, these manes will work great!  You show a lot of grit, $C - I wager we'll see great things from you.
313-complete.title: The Grizzled Den

313-progress.name: Pilot Stonegear
313-progress.text: Hey, $N.  Been to the Grizzled Den yet?  Those Wendigos can be fierce.
313-progress.title: The Grizzled Den

320-complete.name: Pilot Bellowfiz
320-complete.text: Yes, this will do just fine.  I think I'll open a bottle right now and have a taste...
320-complete.title: Return to Bellowfiz

3524-accept.name: Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde
3524-accept.text:
Majestic sea creatures are known to launch themselves at the Darkshore coastline, beached there until they die. Lately, these beasts have been washing ashore in ever-increasing numbers.  I've been sent here by the Temple of the Moon to investigate, but the presence of murlocs along the water has made my research difficult.

There is a giant creature washed ashore just south of Auberdine that is ringed by the foul Greymist murlocs.  Could you go there and retrieve bones from the creature for our study?
3524-accept.title: Washed Ashore

3524-complete.name: Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde
3524-complete.text:
I hope the murloc did not give you much trouble in collecting this for us!  I will be sure to get this on the next hippogryph to Darnassus.  The Temple of the Moon has given me some funds to hand out for assistance; please have some with our thanks.

Your success here emboldens me to offer you a chance to aid the Temple of the Moon further, if you are interested...
3524-complete.title: Washed Ashore

3524-progress.name: Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde
3524-progress.text: It is only recently that these creatures started landing on the coast of Darkshore in such alarming numbers.  I can't help but think that this is an ill omen of some sort.  Recovering a sample of that creature's bones to the south would help us in Darnassus assess this situation!
3524-progress.title: Washed Ashore

36-accept.name: Verna Furlbrow
36-accept.text:
I never thought the day would come when I'd leave the farm.  But the fields are overrun with thieves and it's far too dangerous for us here now.  As soon as Farmer Furlbrow gets the wagon fixed, we'll be on our way.  
 
Maybe you could do me a favor?  Let me scribble down my recipe for Westfall stew.  Please take it to Salma Saldean over on the farm yonder.  The Saldean's farm is just beyond the fork in the road.
36-accept.title: Westfall Stew

36-complete.name: Salma Saldean
36-complete.text: That Verna was always such a sweet lass.  We'll miss her here in Westfall but between you and me, she's a city girl at heart and Stormwind will suit her just fine.  But enough gossip!  Now we can make Westfall Stew!
36-complete.title: Westfall Stew

36-progress.name: Salma Saldean
36-progress.text: I'm going to miss that Verna Furlbrow so much.  I don't suppose you happened to see her on your way here?
36-progress.title: Westfall Stew

373-accept.name: Unknown
373-accept.text:
Searching Edwin VanCleef's person, you discover, among other things, an unsent letter. It is addressed to Baros Alexston, the City Architect of Stormwind, City Hall, Cathedral Square.

It appears to be recently written and sealed.
373-accept.title: The Unsent Letter

38-accept.name: Salma Saldean
38-accept.text:
Help me make some Westfall Stew!  Come back with the following ingredients: 
 
 3 Stringy Vulture Meat 
 3 Goretusk Snouts 
 3 Murloc Eyes 
 3 Okra
38-accept.title: Westfall Stew

38-complete.name: Salma Saldean
38-complete.text: That Okra will thicken up this broth nicely!  Now we just add the Stringy Vulture Meat, a few Murloc Eyes and those delicious Goretusk Snouts.  And we're done!  For all your help, $N, I want you to take today's first batch of Westfall Stew!
38-complete.title: Westfall Stew

38-progress.name: Salma Saldean
38-progress.text:
Come back with the following ingredients: 
 
 3 Stringy Vulture Meat 
 3 Goretusk Snouts 
 3 Murloc Eyes 
 3 Okra
38-progress.title: Westfall Stew

3861-accept.name: Chicken
3861-accept.text:
"Cluck... cluck... cluck... BACAW!

Cluck... cluck... cluck."

The chicken looks up at you and then starts to scratch its claws into the ground. You think it is spelling out a word, but you are not sure what it is. Could it be... S-A-L-D-E-A-N? Before you can ask, the chicken turns away and goes about its business.
3861-accept.title: CLUCK!

3861-complete.name: Chicken
3861-complete.text:
"BACAW!!!"

The chicken starts to gobble up the feed you put down.

After a moment, the chicken looks around, startled. It uncomfortably shuffles back and forth. Is this chicken pregnant? You think you better check underneath it.
3861-complete.title: CLUCK!

3861-progress.name: Chicken
3861-progress.text:
The chicken stares at you with dark, cold eyes. It waits for you hungrily.

"BACAAAW!

Cluck...cluck...cluck."
3861-progress.title: CLUCK!

399-accept.name: Baros Alexston
399-accept.text:
It seems an eternity since I was a boy working the farm in Westfall. They say you can never go back, and it's true. Doubly true in my case, my family's home has been burned down and taken over by thieves.

I have spoken with my father about the fate of some of my possessions, including my first compass. He was unable to save them. However, he also says that they should be hidden away on the farm.

You'll find the Alexston Farmstead west of Sentinel Hill. Perhaps you could go and retrieve it for me?
399-accept.title: Humble Beginnings

413-complete.name: Mountaineer Barleybrew
413-complete.text:
<Mountaineer Barleybrew tastes the Shimmer Stout...>

Oh.  Whoa!  This stuff really puts a shine in your eyes.  I feel like I can see in the dark!
413-complete.title: Shimmer Stout

413-progress.name: Mountaineer Barleybrew
413-progress.text:
Hello, $C!  And what business takes you all the way out here?

Something exciting, I hope.  I haven't been in a good fight in days, and this barrel of ale is almost dry...
413-progress.title: Shimmer Stout

414-accept.name: Mountaineer Barleybrew
414-accept.text:
I've been drinking more of that Shimmer Stout my brother made - it's great stuff!  I want a fellow Mountaineer to try it.  His name's Kadrell, and he's usually patrolling the road through Thelsamar in Loch Modan.

To get to Thelsamar, go southeast through the tunnel, then turn northeast when the path forks into a road.  Follow that road straight into Thelsamar.

Give Mountaineer Kadrell this cask of Shimmer Stout and see what he thinks!
414-accept.title: Stout to Kadrell

414-complete.name: Mountaineer Kadrell
414-complete.text:
Now, let me have a taste...

Magni's Beard!  This stuff gets your head turning!  And it lightens the limbs, too.

I feel like I can fly!
414-complete.title: Stout to Kadrell

4681-accept.name: Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde
4681-accept.text:
That beached creature is not an isolated incident here in Darkshore.  There are more along the coastline and even in the water.  I would like for you to investigate another one that we know of; this one was reported to be in the water due west of Auberdine, close to a sunken vessel.  Return to me with anything that you may recover that would aid our research.

Also, in your travels you may find other creatures.  By all means, if you should discover anything then please bring it to our attention!
4681-accept.title: Washed Ashore

4681-complete.name: Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde
4681-complete.text:
You've been a tremendous help here today; we now have a solid chance at unlocking the mystery of why these creatures choose to beach themselves on the coast of Darkshore.  The idea that they might be fleeing the area around Teldrassil is disturbing.  Should you come across others in your travels, please let me know.  Our research here is but in its infancy.

On behalf of the Temple of the Moon, please accept this as thanks for the effort you have given.  Thank you, $N!
4681-complete.title: Washed Ashore

4681-progress.name: Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde
4681-progress.text: Once you have investigated the creature's remains in the water to the west of here, I should be able to file a proper report with the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus.  Perhaps then we will be closer to discovering the reason why these unfortunate creatures choose to end their lives beached on the coast of Darkshore.
4681-progress.title: Washed Ashore

4723-accept.name: Unknown
4723-accept.text:
The remains of a giant thresher - much larger than one you'd expect to find in Darkshore - lie beached on the coast of the Mist's Edge.  How this creature came to be here is unknown; the group of murlocs that now feast off the carcass of it seem to be much too weak, even in large numbers, to have brought down the beast. 

While some of it has been picked clean, enough of it remains to take a sample for Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde in Auberdine to study.
4723-accept.title: Beached Sea Creature

4723-complete.name: Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde
4723-complete.text: Another discovery - well done $N!  These remains will be properly studied once they get to Darnassus.  Please accept this small honorarium in exchange for the remains you have provided for our study.
4723-complete.title: Beached Sea Creature

4723-progress.name: Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde
4723-progress.text:
Perhaps one day we'll find a means to prevent these poor creatures from ending their lives needlessly on the coast of Darkshore.  Until then, we must continue our research!

Greetings $N - what news do you bring?
4723-progress.title: Beached Sea Creature

4761-accept.name: Terenthis
4761-accept.text:
Your scouting of the furbolg camp is information that Thundris Windweaver should be made aware of.  He graciously serves as the elder of Auberdine, offering sage and just stewardship of the day to day affairs of the village.  Please - share with him your findings to date on the furbolg situation.

I believe he has some ideas of his own on the reasons behind their corruption.  Perhaps you can work with him to enact a plan to restore the balance of nature here!
4761-accept.title: Thundris Windweaver

4761-complete.name: Thundris Windweaver
4761-complete.text: Well met, $c.  Your scouting of the furbolg situation comes at a fortuitous time for us in Auberdine.  For some time we have dealt with not only forest dwellers who are now openly hostile to our presence, but also the outright corruption of the forest itself.  Hopefully you might be able to lend Auberdine aid during these troubling times.
4761-complete.title: Thundris Windweaver

4762-accept.name: Thundris Windweaver
4762-accept.text:
The Cliffspring River has begun turning foul and corrupted.  It empties into the Mist's Edge, and I fear the wash will affect Auberdine soon.  I suspect the Blackwood furbolgs up-river are the cause of the taint, but I also suspect that they aren't the true root of it.

Take this sampling tube and go to the mouth of the river to our north.  Proceed inland to the first waterfall and draw a sample from the pool there.  You'll see a bridge overhead.  Once you have a sample, return to me in Auberdine.
4762-accept.title: The Cliffspring River

4811-accept.name: Sentinel Glynda Nal'Shea
4811-accept.text:
Hostile moonkin roam in ever increasing numbers to our east.  They once were thought to be gentle, almost mystical creatures.  While some continue to hold reverence for them, the safety of Auberdine forces me to keep a more realistic view.

I've received reports that moonkin are being drawn to a large red crystal along Darkshore's eastern mountain range.  No one has any idea what that crystal is, or even if it really exists.  I want you to locate it over there and report back to me what you find.
4811-accept.title: The Red Crystal

62-accept.name: Marshal Dughan
62-accept.text:
The mine in Northshire isn't the only one with problems!  I have reports that the Fargodeep Mine in Elwynn has also become a haven for Kobolds.

Explore the mine and confirm these reports, then return to me.  The mine is almost due south of Goldshire, between the Stonefield and Maclure homesteads.
62-accept.title: The Fargodeep Mine

64-accept.name: Farmer Furlbrow
64-accept.text: It was horrible!  Verna woke me when she heard a ruckus in the fields.  The fields were full of hooligans.  We left in a rush and I forgot to pack my pocket watch.  Verna's pa gave me that watch on our wedding day and I feel just sick knowing those thieves have it.  I left the pocket watch in the wardrobe at the farmhouse.  Look for the field of pumpkins to the West -- you can't miss it.  If you bring it back to me, I'd sure be grateful!
64-accept.title: The Forgotten Heirloom

64-complete.name: Farmer Furlbrow
64-complete.text:
My watch!  Thank you so much, kind sir! 

We are but poor farmers and we have lost our land but please accept this reward as a token of our appreciation.
64-complete.title: The Forgotten Heirloom

64-progress.name: Farmer Furlbrow
64-progress.text: Don't suppose you were able to get my watch?
64-progress.title: The Forgotten Heirloom

65-accept.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
65-accept.text:
The band of wretches responsible for driving the good people of Westfall from the land call themselves The Defias Brotherhood.  I need you to infiltrate this clan of thugs.  We need to know who heads up the cartel and where they are hiding out.  In Lakeshire, in the inn, there is a rogue by the name of Wiley who owes me a favor.

Travel to Lakeshire in the Redridge Mountains, east of Elwynn, and find out what you can.
65-accept.title: The Defias Brotherhood

65-complete.name: Wiley the Black
65-complete.text: So, Stoutmantle sent you?  Well, I owe him.
65-complete.title: The Defias Brotherhood

79093-progress.name: Garion Wendell
79093-progress.text: Have you brought something to add to our collection?
79093-progress.title: Rumi of Gnomeregan: The Collected Works

9-accept.name: Farmer Saldean
9-accept.text:
Look at what has happened to this place!  These lands were once occupied by good farm folk.  But the damned thieves have driven them all off.  Not me, though!  But it seems some Harvest Watchers have taken over the fields.

If you're up for the work, I'd like you to go out and kill twenty of them.  Come back when you're done for your pay.  If you finish up with the ones in my field, clear them from the neighboring fields as well.
9-accept.title: The Killing Fields

9-complete.name: Farmer Saldean
9-complete.text: Good work, friend.  You have earned your pay well.  Who knows, perhaps Westfall will prosper once again.
9-complete.title: The Killing Fields

92744-progress.name: Alba Fairmoon
92744-progress.text: I hope the murlocs did not give you too much trouble?
92744-progress.title: Murloc Gills

92751-progress.name: Sprite Jumpsprocket
92751-progress.text: Did you get a remote detonator? A normal one simply won't do!
92751-progress.title: Detonation at a Distance

92752-progress.name: Alba Fairmoon
92752-progress.text: Were your efforts in Stormwind fruitful?
92752-progress.title: Explosive Consultation

94288-accept.name: Unknown
94288-accept.text: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting 1 Mithril Frag Bomb, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
94288-accept.title: Craftsman's Writ: Mithril Frag Bomb

953-accept.name: Sentinel Tysha Moonblade
953-accept.text:
To the east you will find the ruins of Ameth'Aran. It is now inhabited by the restless spirits of the Highborne that once dwelt within its walls, but once it was a place where the servants of Azshara freely practiced their powerful magics.

I was sent to explore the ruins and came across two large tablets, scrawled with the stories of Ameth'Aran and its fall. While I read the runes, I was accosted by the spirits, and fled.

Please, if you can, venture to the ruins and decipher the tablets in my place.
953-accept.title: The Fall of Ameth'Aran

953-complete.name: Sentinel Tysha Moonblade
953-complete.text:
We have few records from the time around the War of the Ancients, especially near the destruction of the Well of Eternity. Given the upheaval and cataclysmic events that were taking place, it is no big surprise.

Thank you, $N. With your help, my work here is finished, and I will be able to deliver a full report to the Circle.
953-complete.title: The Fall of Ameth'Aran

954-accept.name: Thundris Windweaver
954-accept.text:
The ruins of Bashal'Aran to the east are overrun with demonic minions. The sprites and satyrs that have taken up residence in the area feed upon the magical energies of the area, their powers growing from continued exposure.

Even with that, I have noticed that there is one shrine they will not approach. On the western side of the ruins, atop a small bluff, a strange blue aura permeates... There must be an explanation to the demons' reluctance.

I would like you to investigate it.
954-accept.title: Bashal'Aran

954-complete.name: Asterion
954-complete.text:
Ahh... To what could I possibly owe the exceedingly special honor of a $r such as yourself as company. Truly it says much of my current companions--with no offense to my hosts, the noble grells and satyrs--that your presence could be considered an improvement.

But please, do not let my uncivil tongue drive you from the place. It has indeed been many years, decades even, since I had civil accompaniment.
954-complete.title: Bashal'Aran

955-accept.name: Asterion
955-accept.text:
If I were to relate the story of my life, I have no doubt it would surpass the limits of your patience. Let us say that mine has been a long and painful life, and this spectral form is perhaps the worst torment of all.

I am held here by the means of magic. Though my words may seem disingenuous, I assure you I would be grateful beyond words if you would help me find the means of my imprisonment. A seal binds me, and by examining the earpieces of the sprites and grells, I may find a trace of it.
955-accept.title: Bashal'Aran

955-complete.name: Asterion
955-complete.text: Indeed... The grells of Bashal'Aran do not possess that which I am searching... however they have come into contact with it recently. Recently... I would reckon that by your time, not mine. Recent for me stretches into the veil of the past, almost another Age...
955-complete.title: Bashal'Aran

955-progress.name: Asterion
955-progress.text: Once I have the earrings, I will cast the spell to search for the whereabouts of the seal that binds me. For centuries I have thought on the freedom destroying the seal would bring to me... Perhaps those centuries have taken a toll upon my mind that I might never recover...
955-progress.title: Bashal'Aran

956-accept.name: Asterion
956-accept.text:
If the grells have come into close contact with the seal that binds my eternal prison, I suspect I know the cause. No doubt the seal has come into the possession of the satyr that lead them.

I feel strongly that this must be true, $N. One of the satyr must surely possess it. If you can obtain it, you would bring me so close to passing the bars of my prison that tears would come to my eyes.
956-accept.title: Bashal'Aran

956-complete.name: Asterion
956-complete.text: It... it is hard for me to even believe that what I hold now is that which has held me for so long. Let us waste no time, $N. When the seal is destroyed, I might walk the forests of the earth freely again.
956-complete.title: Bashal'Aran

956-progress.name: Asterion
956-progress.text:
The pillars of this shrine are as the bars of a prison to me, $N. No strength I still possess might break them, and no magic I wield might destroy them...

For a thousand years and more I have stared at them, wondering if at long last I outlived even the stone, would I be free? Or would it be invisible bars that held me then...
956-progress.title: Bashal'Aran

957-accept.name: Asterion
957-accept.text:
It was the craft of one of the most powerful of the Highborne that created the seal that formed my prison. In Ameth'Aran, the ruins to the south that are twin to these, persists even today an ancient flame, blue in color. In this flame this seal could be destroyed.

Be wary in the ruins, $N...
957-accept.title: Bashal'Aran

958-accept.name: Thundris Windweaver
958-accept.text:
$C. A task I would ask of you.

Have you seen the ruins of Ameth'Aran? If not, you will find them on the eastern side of the main road, some ways to the south. Once they were the home of many powerful Highborne, now they are a testament to the destruction their dabblings produced.

I have been told by the Sentinels that the spirits of the Highborne persist, and that they wield their ancient magical implements. Those relics must be appropriated, so that we might destroy them.
958-accept.title: Tools of the Highborne

958-complete.name: Thundris Windweaver
958-complete.text: Though it is surely a figment of my imagination, I feel as though I can almost feel the taint of foul Highborne magic upon them. I will have these destroyed, so that their long dormant evil might never be released again.
958-complete.title: Tools of the Highborne

958-progress.name: Thundris Windweaver
958-progress.text: If only the tools of their undoing could have been destroyed in the cataclysm that destroyed our world... Nonetheless, we must do what we can to ensure that the horrors of our past are not repeated in the future.
958-progress.title: Tools of the Highborne

963-accept.name: Cerellean Whiteclaw
963-accept.text:
In the aftermath of the battles at the Well of Eternity, I heard that Ameth'Aran had been destroyed, its people dead, including my love, Anaya.

I would never have thought, thousands of years later, that memories of Anaya would still haunt my dreams. Wandering the woods of Darkshore in a stupor, I found myself in the ruins of Ameth'Aran... where I saw the haunted spirit of my beloved.

She must be freed, but I lack the heart to do it. Her spirit must be destroyed.
963-accept.title: For Love Eternal

983-accept.name: Wizbang Cranktoggle
983-accept.text:
Hey! Help me with my latest invention, the buzzbox. You can talk to people far away!

Maybe you've already seen them, they're boxes with levers on them. The only problem is they need constant maintenance.

Each one suffers from a different problem, but I made a really smart decision. I placed each one near creatures that have the proper parts to fix that particular machine. Right now Buzzbox 827 is on the fritz. It's just south of Auberdine, real close. It takes 6 Crawler Legs to fix it. I'll pay ya...
983-accept.title: Buzzbox 827

983-complete.name: Unknown
983-complete.text:
As you place the Crawler Legs inside the machine, you hear gears begin to grind. Judging from the banging sounds coming from the Buzzbox, you believe the Crawler Legs are being put in their proper place. Soon the machine begins to hum, and you hear a tiny voice calling out from within.

"Hello? Uhh... Hello! You fixed it! This is Wizbang by the way! Thanks a lot... Hey, you wouldn't want to fix another one, would ya?"
983-complete.title: Buzzbox 827

983-progress.name: Unknown
983-progress.text: Buzzbox 827 sits with an eerie silence. A single flashing light indicates that it needs 6 Crawler Legs to be placed in its holding box.
983-progress.title: Buzzbox 827

98323-progress.name: Senir Whitebeard
98323-progress.text:
Ah, you're back just in time.

What's the matter, lad? You look like you've seen a ghost.
98323-progress.title: Secure the Mountain

984-accept.name: Terenthis
984-accept.text:
Some of my brethren were rescued from a corrupt furbolg in Teldrassil, and I've vowed to stop any more atrocities before more of our kind are injured... or worse.

I have seen a couple hints of corruption in Darkshore already, but I have yet to find any widespread signs. I think it would be logical if the investigation continued with the furbolgs. Would you find one of their camps, and return to me if you see any signs of corruption?
984-accept.title: How Big a Threat?

984-complete.name: Terenthis
984-complete.text:
This is terrible news indeed, $N.

With the furbolgs this close to Auberdine, we will have to prepare ourselves for the inevitable.

Thank you, $N.
984-complete.title: How Big a Threat?

985-accept.name: Terenthis
985-accept.text:
You've already proven adept at scouting our enemy, $N. Do you have what it takes to fight them as well?

Not all adventurers prefer straightforward combat to the art of stealth and evasion.

If you think you're up for the task, then the furbolg camp south of Auberdine is currently the biggest threat to our people. You'll find some of the Blackwood tribe there. Kill 8 pathfinders and 5 windtalkers, and return to me here.
985-accept.title: How Big a Threat?

99158-progress.name: Father Gavin
99158-progress.text: Why did the Light guide you here today?
99158-progress.title: Dawn in the Mountains
